_doc: Survivor barks of the managed base (scripts/prison/prison_barks.gd). Each survivor says at most one short line a game day, as a speech bubble over their head, and only one bubble shows at a time. `every`: seconds between tries, `show`: seconds a bubble stays, `low_days`: days of food or water left that count as low, `low_morale`: morale under it is low, `piles`: dirty places that make the cleaner complain. States are tried in this order (the first that applies and has someone who has not spoken today wins); `who` picks the speaker: any, cook, cleaner, guard, newest. None during raids, attacks, cards or the morning card.
